# July 2025 Salary Increases for Appointed Non-Represented and USW Staff Groups – HRIS Processing Instructions

From: [Sheryl Vitug, Senior HRIS Training & Project Specialist](https://people.utoronto.ca/author/sherylv/)
To: PSEC Staff; Divisional HR Offices; Business Officers

In accordance with the [Compensation update for Confidential, PM, AP and RA / SRA staff memo](https://people.utoronto.ca/memos/2025-compensation-update/), and [USW Local 1998 – Staff Appointed Memorandum of Agreement](https://people.utoronto.ca/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/USW-MOA_20230909.pdf), the following staff groups will have salary increases effective July 1, 2025.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Faculty / Staff Group** | **Salary Increase** |
| PM (1-5), Confidential, Research Associate (RA), Sr. Research Associate (SRA) | * 1.8% ATB increase  and, * Merit Increase based on June 30, 2025 salary |
| PM (6-11) / Advancement Professionals (AP) | * Merit Increase based on June 30, 2025 salary |
| Appointed USW | * 1.8% ATB increase based on June 30, 2025 salary |

Please be advised that all salary increases must be entered into the HRIS system no later than the July 23 monthly payroll close.

To support this process, the following reports must be generated both **prior to** and **after** the salary increases are processed, covering the reporting period from July 1, 2025, to December 31, 9999:

* [HR Data Verification Report as of July 1, 2025](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/HR-Data-Verification-Report.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=fhzj5E&%3d%3d&sdata=bzNLZnZRaHVJZEVNYm93MjFjcXFub1hadjNoalNBbk9Qdzh0S0g1NzRZaz0%3d)
* [Appointment Details Report – ZHSQAPPTDETL](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/Appointment-Detail-Report.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=KNWsFh&%3d%3d&sdata=OUR5bW43Um5Va1lXQkdCTEpadmNpckdjYU1selp6dVA1MWpDb1RxWmtYWT0%3d)
* [Basic Pay Report – ZHSQBASICPAY](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/Basic-Pay-Report.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=0vtP8y&%3d%3d&sdata=SjVSZVhqQTJzRVdabmxyS0QrZTNtZVVqSzBQcHgyeGMzWG83RFJYYTdzYz0%3d)
* [Absence Summary Report (Paid and Unpaid Long Term Absence)](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/Absence-Summary-Report%20.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=EXg3n5&%3d%3d&sdata=QWdVazArMVdFQ1ZoNEZXRUk1aTRFcW9MOXJHWG1VY0R5M2FIV1d1SzFSRT0%3d)

Please note: Any **appointment changes, grid processions, or CC/CFC updates** effective **July 1, 2025, or later** must be processed **after** the salary increases have been completed. This sequencing is essential to minimize exceptions and ensure the accuracy of employee records.

### **Reference Guides**

**1. PM, Confidential, RA, SRA and AP**

**The Fast Entry Upload for Basic Pay and Appointment Detail Infotypes**

The [**Fast Entry Upload Processing Guide**](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/Fast-Entry-Upload-Instructions-for-Salary-Increase-Template-July%202025.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=pV9fA6&%3d%3d&sdata=WkhjOGlZVVBuQkNDOEl0ME9oSjdXRGpFVGNwV29iMnpVVE03MUg4M0FrMD0%3d) provides step-by-step instructions for updating the **Basic Pay Infotype (IT0008)** and the **Appointment Detail Infotype (IT9009)** using the [**Salary Increase Template**](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ax%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/Salary%20Increase%20Template-July-2025.xlsx?d=w0f6ecaa47ff545c58796f1f84a7dcf2d&csf=1&web=1&e=EuemnN&%3d%3d&sdata=Q3lDTDQ3M0xLOHo0ZVVIb1N0eGZJUU1NRmY2dllscjFqT1Fxek9GQUlUST0%3d). This process applies to eligible staff groups, excluding individuals with exceptions on their records.

For employees with exceptions that cannot be processed through the Salary Increase Template, the accompanying chart outlines various scenarios along with the appropriate reference guides to follow.

| **Faculty / Staff Group** | **Scenario** | **Procedure Documentation** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PM (6-11) and Advancement Professional | Staff which have existing July 1, 2025 segments with a future term or continuing end date | [Merit-Increase-for-PM6-11-and-AP-ON-July-1-2025](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/Merit-Increase-for-PM6-11-and-AP-ON-July-1-2025.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=WOA0CP&%3d%3d&sdata=NURXZDgxbXEvTmdDMGQrL0ozSk9ENlhVZVAvRVZ0OVBwSHMxdkFxZVRROD0%3d) |
| Staff which have existing segments, on July 1, 2025, and segments after, with either a future term or continuing end date | [Merit-Increase-for-PM6-11-and-AP-After-July-1-2025](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/Merit-Increase-for-PM6-11-and-AP-After-July-1-2025.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=tpbNbi&%3d%3d&sdata=eXRvZGVuRVBjYlhwbkVFZWdueXEwaVM3aU5mMldnVGRGODRGYkpMaStEYz0%3d) |
| PM (1-5), Confidential, RA and SRA | Staff which have existing July 1, 2025 segments with a future term or continuing end date | [ATB-Merit-Increase-for-PM1-5-Confidential-RA-SRA-ON-July-1-2025](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/ATB-Merit-Increase-for-PM1-5-Confidential-RA-SRA-ON-July-1-2025.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=kntc8q&%3d%3d&sdata=a09FZERVOHNmWURNNS9JNG5hcUFiSjVJdHlOSzFrclppNXVnYXdtU2ZhMD0%3d) |
| Staff which have existing segments, on July 1, 2025, and segments after, with either a future term or continuing end date | [ATB-Merit-Increase-for-PM1-5-Confidential-RA-SRA-After-July-1-2025](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/ATB-Merit-Increase-for-PM1-5-Confidential-RA-SRA-After-July-1-2025.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=ce9SCB&%3d%3d&sdata=Q21YQXg2ZkdqOEhseThVV05xMDhUUmcvSnlXT0diRE1xMzQ3ZzdJU2RRND0%3d) |

**2. Centralized ATB Increase for USW Appointed Staff – July 9**

The **Across-the-Board (ATB) salary increase** for **USW Appointed staff** will be processed centrally on **July 9 at 5:00 p.m.**, excluding employees with exceptions on their records.

Departments are required to run the [**USW ATB Exception and Update Report**](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/USW-ATB-Exception-and-Update-Report-July-2025.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=Bw39Zz&%3d%3d&sdata=OW1NZUhDTGVndUJJZUNjOWJJeklLalk5Z3MzTXIrQm5OM1ZYVEcxV1VNbz0%3d) both **before and after** the central update. For employees excluded from the automated process due to exceptions, please consult the [**USW Exception Descriptions and Corrective Action Reference Chart**](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/USW-Exception-Descriptions-and-Corrective-Action-Reference-Chart-July-2025.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=RNcXMT&%3d%3d&sdata=OW03ck5TZUlyM3RrQy8yVE11MUpvWW9BYy8veXJDYm5kVGh5UlcyREtNMD0%3d) to determine the appropriate transactions to be executed manually.

The chart outlines various exception scenarios along with the corresponding reference guides to support accurate and timely processing.

| **Scenario** | **Processing Details and Procedure Documentation** |
| --- | --- |
| Employee has July 1, 2025 segment in Appointment Detail screen, with future or term end date and no segment after July 1, 2025. | [ATB-Increase-Process-for-USW-with-Segment-ON-July1-2025](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/ATB-Increase-Process-for-USW-with-Segment-ON-July1-2025.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=oCR2on&%3d%3d&sdata=Zjl2TnF5QWEwWEtiTkMwODlybHIwa0xGejdLSjNyYTJ5Y1R5eDFncWpUcz0%3d) |
| Employee has July 1, 2025 segment and one or more entries after July 1, 2025 in Appointment Detail screen. | [ATB-Increase-Process-USW-with-Segments-AFTER-July1-2025](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/ATB-Increase-Process-for-USW-with-Segment-AFTER-July1-2025.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=1ZwQz0&%3d%3d&sdata=WWZJV1prOHI0emR0TUlCNFdaVGY4d2grODVUTUNyd2Y4V01aQ3hzNDZOWT0%3d) |

The [July 2025 Timeline for ATB Increase for Appointed USW](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/%3Ab%3A/r/sites/psec-hris/HRIS%20Content/Timeline-for-July-2025-ATB-Increase-USW.pdf?csf=1&web=1&e=PkY3Qa&%3d%3d&sdata=VlBiTGNsMGZXZmtIY05IOURVemYvVDhNVVgzY0RJeWttS1RvYnZQKzByQT0%3d) and all resources listed below are available on the [HR Systems & Training Support Centre](https://utoronto.sharepoint.com/sites/psec-hris?%3d%3d&sdata=YS90K0JZUlpuTXBvaEhBWmRMWXJBSjhtbnVjNVZxUVhsalBNSHh6Zmhwaz0%3d).

### **HRIS Support – July Salary Increase Information Session & One-on-One Assistance**

**The HRIS Support Team will be offering the following opportunities to assist with July salary increase process:**

* **A July Salary Increase Information Session** for **Business Officers / Payroll Officers** will be available on July 8, 10:30 am – 11:30 am. [Register](https://can01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fhcm17.sapsf.com%2Fsf%2Flearning%3FdestUrl%3Dhttps%253a%252f%252funiversi011.plateau.com%252flearning%252fuser%252fdeeplink_redirect.jsp%253flinkId%253dREGISTRATION%2526scheduleID%253d4005%2526fromSF%253dY%26company%3Duniversi05P4&data=05%7C02%7Calex.nathan%40UTORONTO.CA%7C13ad1706eb174df2d26708ddb3fc4640%7C78aac2262f034b4d9037b46d56c55210%7C0%7C0%7C638864618362622693%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=k4Dil4vIMHTRxdwAwt0LTYz65m%2BpPrVejz6hzGv0GY0%3D&reserved=0) through the LMS to join the event.
* **Get Help for July Increases One-on-One** support sessions can be booked by submitting a ticket through [HR Service Centre](https://can01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.uoft.me%2Fhrisgethelp&data=05%7C02%7Calex.nathan%40UTORONTO.CA%7C13ad1706eb174df2d26708ddb3fc4640%7C78aac2262f034b4d9037b46d56c55210%7C0%7C0%7C638864618362645869%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=JmbxX%2FIYrYolFLf9rOcZNzSyMfPl0A5xFzvOO6tTK4c%3D&reserved=0) before **July 21.**

### **Questions and Contact Information**

Questions with respect to eligibility for Appointed Staff Groups should be directed to your [Divisional HR Office](https://people.utoronto.ca/contact/).

For USW, Central Payroll Services will update the Basic Pay IT0008 for those employees receiving a Supplemental Unemployment Benefit (SUB) on July 1 for an approved leave of absence. Approved leaves of absence include Pregnancy, Parental, Adoption, Primary Caregiver Leave or Compassionate Family Caregiver Leave. Business Officers must update the Appointment Detail (IT9009) to reflect those updates. If the employee is also receiving a grid progression in July, the Department must inform **Central Payroll Services by July 21 payroll forms / changes deadline.**

If you need assistance with HRIS processing, please submit a ticket to HRIS Help Desk using the [HR Service Centre.](https://can01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fuoft.me%2Fhrisgethelp&data=05%7C02%7Calex.nathan%40UTORONTO.CA%7C13ad1706eb174df2d26708ddb3fc4640%7C78aac2262f034b4d9037b46d56c55210%7C0%7C0%7C638864618362668970%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=EgXoPS1D1xSULp3Q3RfOFmqh22QcthV5G3btud3Q2Fs%3D&reserved=0)
